pages.text: $(2)1. Install$()$(br)Drop the jar into your mods folder. $(o)Install Patchouli to get this book$() - the mod runs fine without it.$(br2)$(2)2. Configs$()$(br)First launch generates everything under $(4)config/damageoverhaul/$().

$(2)3. Tooltips$()$(br)Hover weapons/armor to see distributions and resistances live.$(br2)$(2)4. Edit & Reload$()$(br)Edit any config, save, run $(6)/damageoverhaul reload$() - $(o)no restart required$().
